elements.commandsql:
SELECT kbi_f.id                                                                                                as fid,
       kbi_f.name,
       kbi_c.fullname,
       COUNT(DISTINCT kbi_fp.id)                                                                               AS all_posts,
       COUNT(DISTINCT kbi_fp.userid) AS contributors,
       COUNT(DISTINCT kbi_fp.id) /
       GREATEST(PERIOD_DIFF(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m'), DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(kbi_cm.added), '%Y%m')), 1)  as avg_month,
       COUNT(DISTINCT kbi_fp.id) /
       GREATEST(CEILING(DATEDIFF(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(kbi_cm.added), '%Y%m%d')) / 7),
                1)                                                                                         as avg_week,
       COUNT(DISTINCT kbi_fp.id) /
       GREATEST(DATEDIFF(DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y%m%d'), DATE_FORMAT(FROM_UNIXTIME(kbi_cm.added), '%Y%m%d')), 1) as avg_day,
       (SELECT WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(p2.created)) FROM mdl_forum_discussions d2 JOIN mdl_forum_posts p2 ON p2.discussion = d2.id WHERE d2.forum = kbi_f.id GROUP BY WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(p2.created)) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, WEEKDAY(FROM_UNIXTIME(p2.created)) ASC LIMIT 1)                                                                                     AS popular_day,
       (SELECT HOUR(FROM_UNIXTIME(p2.created)) FROM mdl_forum_discussions d2 JOIN mdl_forum_posts p2 ON p2.discussion = d2.id WHERE d2.forum = kbi_f.id GROUP BY HOUR(FROM_UNIXTIME(p2.created)) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, HOUR(FROM_UNIXTIME(p2.created)) ASC LIMIT 1)                                                                                   AS popular_hour,
       (SELECT CEILING(DAYOFMONTH(FROM_UNIXTIME(p2.created))/7.0) FROM mdl_forum_discussions d2 JOIN mdl_forum_posts p2 ON p2.discussion = d2.id WHERE d2.forum = kbi_f.id GROUP BY CEILING(DAYOFMONTH(FROM_UNIXTIME(p2.created))/7.0) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CEILING(DAYOFMONTH(FROM_UNIXTIME(p2.created))/7.0) ASC LIMIT 1)                                                                                   AS popular_week
FROM mdl_forum kbi_f
       JOIN mdl_modules kbi_m ON kbi_m.name = 'forum'
       LEFT JOIN mdl_course_modules kbi_cm ON kbi_cm.course = kbi_f.course AND kbi_cm.instance = kbi_f.id AND kbi_cm.module = kbi_m.id
       LEFT JOIN mdl_course kbi_c ON kbi_c.id = kbi_f.course
       LEFT JOIN mdl_forum_discussions kbi_fd ON kbi_fd.forum = kbi_f.id
       LEFT JOIN mdl_forum_posts kbi_fp ON kbi_fp.discussion = kbi_fd.id

WHERE kbi_f.course = :courseid
  AND kbi_c.visible = 1
GROUP BY kbi_f.id, kbi_f.name, kbi_c.fullname, kbi_cm.added
ORDER BY all_posts DESC, kbi_f.name
